role: Kanban scalar cards, tasks and comments
known_patches: Integer identity schemas including shorthand id schemas
Synthetic User1/2/3 with source flags preserved
Card create retains actual parent board; declared camelCase date/completion aliases map correctly
Comment list resolves actual cardId scope
limitations: All 98 original tools remain; only nine listed write tools are certified. create_or_move_card covers create_card; actual movement is not claimed.
update_card.listId is not mapped and id-typed FKs are not writable. delete_card only writes updated_by_id through soft-delete executor and does not remove/mark Card deleted.
move_card_to_completed clears no completion metadata when isCompleted=false; task/comment source ACLs have global editor/manager branches rather than matching target board/project.
Comment.data is JSON-shaped in source seeds but text create/update store scalar strings. Soft-delete audit expressions may remain literal; comment lists still include rows with deleted_at.
list_comments.beforeId pagination, full project creation/container-link side effects, imports/GitHub sync, activity/notifications and binary attachments are not certified.
Source create_comment checks board membership but does not enforce can_comment flag. No comprehensive permission-isolation claim is made.
